title: Donald Trump's Pal Kelsey Grammer Says He's Contemplating Running for President: ‘Maybe It's Time'
text:

 News Finance More Mail Search the web Advertisement Advertisement Return to Homepage Donald Trump's Pal Kelsey Grammer Says He's Contemplating Running for President: ‘Maybe It's Time'
 Samantha Ibrahim Wed, November 11, 2026 at 9:41 p.m. UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Hollywood icon Kelsey Grammer could be adding one more moniker to his résumé - president of the United States.
 The Frasier alum, 71, recently revealed if he would ever consider running for political office.
 Kelsey Grammer Said a Presidential Campaign Is in the Cards for Him
 'I've been thinking maybe it's time,' Kelsey Grammer divulged in a recent interview. BY: NEWSNATION
 During a chat with NewsNation's Katie Pavlich Tonight , Grammer was asked if ever contemplated being the POTUS.
 "I've been thinking maybe it's time. We'll see," the actor noted. He then discussed how his new film, Call to Action: America the Beautiful , mirrors several individuals in Congress.
 Kelsey Grammer Discussed Narrating His New Nature Documentary
 Kelsey Grammer is an outspoken conservative. BY: MEGA
 Grammer narrates Call to Action: America the Beautiful , and the film celebrates America's 250th birthday by taking a look at the nation's nature conversation efforts.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "The Everglades section of this particular movie is fabulous, you know, because it is a swamp, right?" he explained. "Well, maybe it's a little too far south. But I noticed that the alligators and the crocodiles, both of which inhabit the Everglades, resemble a lot of the people in Congress ."
 The Cheers star went on to note how the "last decade of my life basically has been more of an avocation and a vocation."
 "I've been representing sort of American history with my voice and my presence and, you know, narrating a lot of things that are documentary driven. And it's all in praise of the country. And I love this land, I always have," he said.
 Kelsey Grammer Is a Vocal Member of the Republican Party
 Kelsey Grammer and Donald Trump have been friends for years. BY: MEGA
 Grammer has been an outspoken conservative and a longtime pal of Donald Trump for years.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement This past June, Trump, 80, and the Emmy Award winner met at the White House 's Oval Office for a private meeting. Grammer was in Washington, D.C., to promote his pre-Revolutionary War film, Young Washington .
 A source told Deadline at the time, the pair "talked politics and their families, along with the movie." Grammer also reportedly "left with a big bag of swag, including hats and a Bible."
 Running for High Office Would 'Tick a Box' for Kelsey Grammer
 Donald Trump and Kelsey Grammer had a meeting at the White House earlier this year. BY: MEGA
 Earlier this year, the Grammnet Productions head also expressed his political aspirations , telling Us Weekly he would "consider" running for president.
 "It would possibly tick that box for me, in terms of the service I feel I should have given to my fellow man - to my fellow countrymen - that I missed in the military," Grammer noted, adding: "Maybe that would be the way to do it. I have wrestled with it."
 "It's likely I will at least throw my hat in the ring in some way," he said.
